title.narrative: Studio Tamani, une plateforme médiatique pour le dialogue, la citoyenneté et la réduction des tensions liées au contexte politique au Mali

description.narrative: Contract related to: Studio Tamani, une plateforme médiatique pour le dialogue, la citoyenneté et la réduction des tensions liées au contexte politique au Mali - This action aims to support the continued existence of an active and structured civil society in Mali in a context of increasing restrictions by the current regime. Actions will cover three main areas.The involvementofMalian civilsocietyorganisationsinthepreparationand observation of elections, to provide theMalian population with reliable information about the election processand to counter disinformation,as well astheestablishment of platformsfor national stakeholders to stimulate debate within Malian society. Efforts will also be made to provide Malian society with access to research and analysis to allow for informed debate on current issues of concern relating to, amongst others, the political, economic and security situation.
